sections.text_helper: Section 20.4.3 "Multiple processing" in chapter 20 (Neural-ART accelerator™ (NPU)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1025.
sections.section_content:
Implements several independent simple processing chains, like the one in Figure126.
[Figure 127. Multiple processing]
The number of independent chains is limited by the available hardware resources. It cannot
exceed half the number of available stream engines, that is, five pairs of stream engines on
Neural-ART 14, thus five chains.
